verdict.rationale: Ramp's evidence pack covers cards, expense management, bill pay, ERP sync, and banking integrations, but nothing describes receiving inbound payments via local account details (e.g., local IBAN/ACH/SWIFT receiving accounts) in multiple currencies — this is a receivables/multi-currency collection capability not mentioned anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: any mention of local currency receiving accounts, multi-currency invoicing/collections, or global payment-in details.
